data.text: Council convened on: Oil spikes 15%. Blind votes are in; members, make your case.

STI down 1.96% over one month with 20-day volatility at 8.42%, showing pre-existing stress.
USD/SGD at 1.2789 with SGD up 0.96% over one month; no oil-driven reversal visible yet.
No sector-level proxies in our data; direct oil-exposure assessment not possible.
STI's bank and REIT-heavy composition amplifies sensitivity to any MAS tightening response.
SGX chairman flagged liquidity concerns, compounding vulnerability to external shocks.
